name: goldfish-qp
description: Click any abbreviation, ticket or pull request in Claude's replies to see what it means. Definitions come from your own files, trackers and GitHub, are marked current or stale, and cost no extra LLM calls. A fork of Quick Peek.

window.title: Preview paths in a window
window.description: On macOS in the terminal, show a path's preview in a small window by the pointer: the file's Quick Look thumbnail, its kind, size and age. Off, the terminal shows a one-line card over the path.
